searchText: Have there been any discussions around requiring say ERA/ERA1 file support in at least N client codebases as a prerequisite to EIP-4444? Knowing that we have an established cross-client means to recover all the historical state would make me a lot more bullish on 4444. I don’t think there is a need for every client to support era generation (would be nice) but any client pruning history should be able to somehow ingest era IMO not sure if that answers your question
